children: British counterterrorism police are holding five men on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act after their arrests near RAF Fairford, an air base used by U.S. forces during the war with Iran.

The men were initially detained on suspicion of explosives offenses after three vehicles raised concerns near the Gloucestershire base. Army bomb-disposal specialists are examining the vehicles, while police established a 400-meter security cordon and evacuated about 85 nearby households.
The Metropolitan Police, which is leading the terrorism investigation, said the situation appeared contained. Authorities have not confirmed that the suspected activity was directed at RAF Fairford.

For investors, the arrests highlight the security risks surrounding military infrastructure as the Iran conflict continues. Any confirmed attempt to target a base used for U.S. operations could heighten geopolitical concerns, potentially affecting defense stocks, energy markets and traditional safe-haven assets while adding another source of uncertainty for broader markets.

RAF Fairford hosts U.S. Air Force units and has been used for American strikes against Iranian missile sites since Britain authorized operations from the base following the start of the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran in February.
The U.S. Air Force said American and British personnel remain alert to potential threats but declined to discuss specific security measures.

The arrests also come amid increased concern in Britain about hostile-state activity. U.K. officials said earlier this year that national-security cases involving countries including Iran and Russia had risen sharply in late 2025.
Residents near the base were temporarily moved to a local leisure center while specialists continued examining the scene.

title: UK holds five on terror suspicion near U.S.-used air base
